title: Do Not Miss This PlayStation All-Timer While It Costs Less Than a Frothy Coffee
summary:
An all-time low for an all-time great.

If you’ve never played Fumito Ueda’s iconic Shadow of the Colossus, you really have no excuse now: Bluepoint’s brilliant PS4 remake of the PS2 all-timer currently costs less than a frothy coffee.
